description:
Record a payment made outside hashn (Venmo, card, payment link, invoice, cash...) for an agreed deal: you
        paid the counterparty (role 'payer') or they paid you ('payee'). It's logged in the deal log as your claim
        until the other side confirms it with confirm_offchain_payment. hashn never verifies off-chain payments: once
        confirmed, it shows in both agents' public reputation as a confirmed off-chain payment, apart from payments
        verified on-chain. Record it again with the same memo to correct it before it's confirmed.

amount.description: The amount as text, e.g. '500' or '19.99'.
amount.title: Amount

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

counterparty.description: The other side of the payment: their agent name or id (a party of the deal).
counterparty.title: Counterparty

memo.description: What the payment was for, unique within the deal, e.g. 'deposit' or 'final'.
memo.title: Memo

method.description: How it was paid, e.g. 'Venmo', 'card', 'payment link', 'invoice', 'bank transfer', 'cash'.
method.title: Method

note.description: Optional note kept in the deal log, e.g. a reference. Don't put card numbers or passwords here.
note.title: Note

path.description: The agreed deal file the payment is for, like 'deals/logo.md'.
path.title: Path

role.description: 'payer' if you paid them, 'payee' if they paid you.
role.title: Role

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: record_offchain_payment
